changes: Numeric subset for a lossless DC adaptation: demands, active generator maxima/linear offers, branch x/tap/rateA retained. Source resistance, shunts, reactive power and voltage magnitudes omitted. Uniform 110 kV normalization; effective Line x = source x * tap * 110^2 / 100 ohm. A nonzero r=x/100 placeholder satisfies PyPSA strict consistency but is unused by this lossless solve. Source 30-degree branch angle limits retained. Ratings are PGLib model estimates, not measured equipment ratings. Not an AC benchmark reproduction.
